reason: The currently built q route files fail strict direction-only input validation, so protocol v3 stops before registration and before SUMO.

source_repairs.pair_construction: dirsplit/predict.py now derives the second edge as the complement of the same q10, q50 or q90 arm; newly generated pairs sum to one by construction.
source_repairs.split_validation: Every station and case must contain exactly two finite 96-slot series in [0,1], with every slot sum within 0.001 of one. Missing keys, wrong lengths and NaN fail closed.
source_repairs.lineage_validation: demand_meta.json must bind direction_split.json and all three live route files by SHA-256.
source_repairs.route_population_validation: q10, q50 and q90 must have identical 15-minute departure profiles; flow/trip inputs and invalid departure times are refused.
source_repairs.seed_validation: The executed ScenarioSpec seed_set and seed-health variant must match the preregistered arm. Identical inserted counts are allowed; an identity mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE.
source_repairs.registration_safety: Known-invalid inputs are rejected before an append-only registration version is written and before the SUMO matrix starts.

interpretation: The source defect is fixed, but historical/current built route populations remain confounded. Rebuilding provenance-bound demand inputs is a Fas 0B input repair, not permission to open Fas 2-4 or overwrite prior evidence.
next_valid_action: Create a fresh demand build with the corrected split construction, verify equal departure populations, then freeze and run a new protocol-v3 Gate S registration/outcome.
